question: Which deities are invoked to protect the entire body always?
premises: The stainless one is asked to protect always.
Ambuvati is also invoked for protection.
The object of protection is the entire body.
inference: The stainless one and Ambuvati are invoked to protect the entire body at all times.
uncertainties: Form 'ambuvaty' may be a variant or sandhi-related spelling.
plain_english: May the stainless one always protect, and may Ambuvati protect my entire body.
